name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Changed
- **Bigger bar icons.** Every icon in the bot list's top and bottom bars is 25% larger, glyph and click area
  together — the bell, ＋, Settings, update, search and sidebar toggle on the Mac, and the bell, gear and ＋
  on the phone.
- **The waiting list looks like the list it belongs to.** On the phone the sheet now opens at the height its
  rows need instead of a mostly empty panel, its header sits just under the grabber, and each row carries
  the unread badge on the avatar's corner — with the bot's name, time and last line aligned the same way as
  the bot list.

### Fixed
- **No more blue ring around a waiting row on the Mac.** That outline was the system's keyboard-focus ring;
  rows show a hover highlight now and are still usable from the keyboard.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown by your Hermes host to connect this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
